## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-ci`, `area:frost`.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

Four tests skipped everywhere but cc 10.0, although the code they cover also serves cc 10.3:

| Test | Gate before | Why cc 10.3 is in scope |
|---|---|---|
| `norm/graph/test_frost_norm_affine.py` (autouse fixture) | `!= (10, 0)` | the FROST norm rows list `archs = {(10, 0), (10, 3)}` (`norm/fprop/engines.py`, `norm/bprop/engines.py`) |
| `core/jax/conftest.py` (autouse fixture) | `compute_capability != "10.0"` | `cudnn.jax.call` has no arch check; `linear_attention/jax/conftest.py` already accepts `("10.0", "10.3")` |
| `gemm/jax/test_grouped_gemm_canonical_jax.py::test_canonical_jax_glu_hadamard_quant_delayed_act` | `!= (10, 0)` | the GLU-Hadamard-quant kernel accepts SM100+, and cc 10.3 runs the same epilogue barriers |
| `sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_split_binding.py::test_standalone_split_requires_caller_workspace_without_allocating` | `!= (10, 0)` | the d64 split decode goes through the SM100 row, which spans cc 10.3 |

Each gate now accepts `(10, 0)` and `(10, 3)`. No product code changes.

## Why

These cases never ran on a B300.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test only.

## Testing

B300 (cc 10.3), develop `64ed3dfe` with its own extension, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, JAX 0.12.0.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, run from `test/python`:

| Module | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `norm/graph/test_frost_norm_affine.py` | 114 skipped | 114 passed |
| `core/jax/test_call_jax.py` | 13 skipped | 13 passed |
| `gemm/jax/test_grouped_gemm_canonical_jax.py::test_canonical_jax_glu_hadamard_quant_delayed_act` | 1 skipped | 1 passed |
| `sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_split_binding.py` | 181 passed, 25 skipped | 183 passed, 23 skipped |

The 23 remaining skips in the split-binding module are the dense-binding cases it reuses, which pin each part on purpose: cc 10.3 has its own variants in `test_sdpa_native_arch_binding.py`. Not run on cc 10.0, where every gate admits the part as before.

files.patch:
@@ -9,5 +9,5 @@ def cuda_device():
     import jax
 
     device = jax.local_devices()[0]  # where uncommitted test arrays land
-    if device.platform != "gpu" or str(getattr(device, "compute_capability", "")) != "10.0":
-        pytest.skip("JAX tests require the default JAX device to be an SM100 GPU")
+    if device.platform != "gpu" or str(getattr(device, "compute_capability", "")) not in ("10.0", "10.3"):
+        pytest.skip("JAX tests require the default JAX device to be an SM100 or SM103 GPU")

@@ -515,8 +515,8 @@ def test_canonical_jax_glu_hadamard_quant_delayed_act(monkeypatch):
     from cudnn.gemm.cutedsl.grouped.glu_hadamard_quant import api, jax_api
     from cudnn.gemm.cutedsl.grouped.glu_hadamard_quant import moe_blockscaled_grouped_gemm_glu_hadamard_quant as kernel_module
 
-    if get_compute_capability() != (10, 0):
-        pytest.skip("Exercises the SM100 epilogue barriers")
+    if get_compute_capability() not in ((10, 0), (10, 3)):
+        pytest.skip("Exercises the SM100-family epilogue barriers")
     original_sync = kernel_module._partial_cta_sync
 
     @dsl_user_op

@@ -144,8 +144,8 @@ def test_standalone_split_requires_caller_workspace_without_allocating(native, m
     from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100, sdpa_fwd_wrapper_dsl_sm100
     from cuda.bindings import driver
 
-    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 0) or not _dsl_installed():
-        pytest.skip("native split decode requires SM100 and CuTe DSL")
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in ((10, 0), (10, 3)) or not _dsl_installed():
+        pytest.skip("native split decode requires SM100 or SM103 and CuTe DSL")
     torch.manual_seed(19)
     q = torch.randn(2, 1, 8, 64, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(1, 2)
     k = torch.randn(2, 128, 2, 64, device="cuda", dtype=q.dtype).transpose(1, 2)
